Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Microfiber Dining Chair, 30.5"H, 2-Pack, Brown
Colors: Brown
Materials: Microfiber fabric; Hardwood frame; Metal legs
18.5"W x 20.9"D x 30.5"H Microfiber fabric over hardwood frame; metal legs have black finish Along with seating, these chairs bring retro fun to a dining table, living room or desk Assemble in 15 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty. Simple sloped seats are paired with tall black metal bases for a classic Mid-century style. The microfiber has a distressed finish to give these bar stools a hint of vintage style -- but with the modern conveniences of easy cleaning and durability.
